subject.title: [Feature]: Thread replies when agent uses tools; top-level for conversational responses

question: Should Slack support a default-off tool-use-sensitive reply-placement mode, and should it extend `replyToMode` or live as a separate `channels.slack.thread.replyOnToolUse` flag?
rationale: This adds new config and changes visible Slack reply placement, so repository policy requires maintainer intent before implementation chooses precedence, streaming behavior, and upgrade semantics.

options.title: Extend reply mode
options.body: Add an explicit Slack-owned reply-placement policy under the existing `replyToMode` family so per-channel/chat-type precedence stays in one place.

options.title: Add separate flag
options.body: Add the proposed default-off `thread.replyOnToolUse` flag and document exactly how it interacts with `replyToMode`, streaming, and DMs.

options.title: Decline heuristic
options.body: Keep the existing static modes and document `replyToMode=first|all` plus per-channel overrides as the supported way to reduce Slack channel clutter.

recommendation.title: Extend reply mode
recommendation.body: Add an explicit Slack-owned reply-placement policy under the existing `replyToMode` family so per-channel/chat-type precedence stays in one place.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the closest per-channel reply-placement change and appears in recent Slack reply/threading history.
